title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. xanthochlora
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. xanthochlora, commonly known as the Golden Lady's mantle, is a subspecies of the Alchemilla vulgaris plant, a type of flowering plant in the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe irritated skin and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. xanthochlora are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
